review.notes: Structure pass on the full file plus a digit-sequence sweep of extracted text from all 21 physical PDF pages; page 1 title/abstract read line-by-line and prompt-box pages 19-21 rendered at 115 dpi with 300 dpi crops of every printed fence line. The appendix C.1 prompt boxes are the main damage: the PDF prints two boxes ('First Gencorrect Round' p.19, 'Next Gencorrect Round' p.20-21, the second continuing across the page break with no banner or fence at the break) whose inner ```cpp/``` lines are literal printed text. OCR wrapped each page-span of the boxes in ```markdown fences, so the inner printed 3-backtick lines terminate the wrapper early and everything from the second box's system prompt to end of file sits in one open code block; the wrapper also miscounted backticks (````cpp printed as ```cpp, ```cpp printed as ``` and as ``cpp, a printed ```` closer copied as ```). Repair keeps the OCR's code-block rendering device but lengthens the wrappers so the printed fences stay literal. Absent 3+-digit numbers on pages 2, 4, 7, 8, 9 are chart-internal axis ticks and bar labels of embedded figures; the p.1 arXiv:2609.02849v2 stamp is a publisher margin stamp, not body text. Line-level prose proofreading of pages 2-18 was not completed within the review budget, hence partial coverage.
